scope: 2025 CCPC Jinan A C E F G H I J K L
limitations: Independent exact small-instance checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing. Optimized DSU-on-tree, PAM, segment-tree and Fenwick implementations are not benchmarked.

A.method: all a,b modulo 2^w for w=1..8 against complete power cycles; official and random 64-bit checks

C.method: greedy chain progress versus exhaustive skip/advance decision DP

E.method: edge-minus-vertex separator formula versus all monochromatic subsets and exact Steiner subtree intersections

F.method: all assignments of random small intervals versus separating flexible blocks and two-state fixed-run DP

G.method: all 6986 triangulation-difference coefficient checks, exact interval coverage through 1e9, and complete matrix-chain DP for 26470 small/boundary/random targets

H.method: enumerated exact hash polynomials of unordered binary trees and all size*j<=12 forest sums; official n=15 example

I.method: exact palindrome suffix/fixed-context increments versus all literal CCPC substrings; both official operation examples; excludes optimized PAM implementation

J.method: all permutations for random trees through n=7, compressed ancestor edges and laminar unlocking versus lexicographically first valid permutation; includes invalid targets

K.method: every legal Alice sequence through n=7, verify all cards and literal game score; exhaustive Bob permutations through n=4

L.method: dependency-tree path updates after swaps versus literal queue simulation and interval sums
